caption: The drawing features a mechanical device composed primarily of wood and metal elements, depicted against a plain off-white background. The main structure consists of a rectangular, green-painted wooden box with visible wood grain and some areas of minor chipping or wear. Two wide, flat wooden legs provide stability at the base. On top of the box, a hinged wooden lid, also green, is propped open, revealing a series of evenly spaced, upright metal blades or teeth attached underneath the lid. Below this, inside the box and running horizontally, there is a cylindrical wooden roller with a spiral groove, appearing tan or light brown in color. The roller is mounted on metal axles, with a large metal crank attached to one side. The crank handle is made of wood and is cylindrical, attached at the end of a bent metal arm. Metal screws and other fittings are visible at joints and corners. The device is oriented at an angle so that both the side and front of the object are visible.
title: Meat Chopper
